أُخُوَّهٌ an inf. n. of 1: and also [used as] a simple subst. (TA.) See 1. ―
-b2- When it does not relate to birth, it means (assumed tropical:) Conformity, or similarity; and combination, agreement, or unison, in action. (Ibn-'Arafeh, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
